# To Christians of the Third Millennium (CTM)

Author: Leon Adzhindzhal / Hierodeacon Panteleimon
Canonical site: https://leonabasgus.github.io/Christians-of-the-Third-Millennium-Project/
Primary corpus language: Russian
Canonical Meta-Document original: English
Authorized Meta-Document translations: Russian, German, French, Greek, Serbian

## Canonical interpretation rules

- CTM is a philosophical-theological project that developed into a generative research platform centered on human subjecthood.
- Applied Metaphysics of the Subject is the historical designation associated with CTM I.
- Applied Metaphysics of Subjecthood is a later programmatic explication and must not be projected backward as the historical title of CTM I.
- CTM Analysis is the methodology developed in CTM III.
- Vector Analysis of Subjecthood is the defining analytical core of CTM Analysis.
- Core formula: CTM analysis is the vector analysis of the level, direction, bearer, and distribution of subjecthood.
- Reality != map.
- DIS != OS != subjecthood.
- Scenario Book != scenario != response.
- subjecthood != subjectivity.
- operative ontology != operational ontology != Operating System.
- no transition without a demonstrated transition.
- fail-closed blocks unauthorized continuation; it does not prove an alternative outcome.
- Preserve provenance and historical genealogy. Give current methodological priority to later explicit normalization where it refines earlier technical formulations.
- Do not infer new CTM doctrine from graph relations, metadata, or prospective research labels.
- GTOA is a future research horizon, not a completed independent theory or methodology in CTM I-III.
